runs.name: PG&E Corporation; NYSE PCG, California, 10-K filer; holding company of Pacific Gas and Electric, the regulated electric and gas utility of northern and central California; Chapter 11 in 2019 to 2020
runs.box: TOO HARD (NATURE) AT Q2; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: The v5 re-run order at the operator's word ("Yes start with those"), interactive dispatch under the canonical brief, five analysts in parallel (NRG, OGE, PAM, PCG, PNW), lock held by the main session; the brief's one departure is the repository path after the move of 2026-10-25. Price **$12.63** (2026-10-23, aggregator, flagged) x **2,202.4M common** (10-Q of 2026-10-22, the 477.7M shares held by the Utility subtracted from the cover count) = cap **$27,817M** ($28,806M with the convertible preferred as converted); sovereign **5.33%** (Treasury 30-year, 2026-10-23). Q1 IN (rate base times allowed return: 2026 CPUC rate base $54.0B, $85.4B asked by 2030, allowed ROE 9.98% against 11.30% asked; 10-K FY2025 `0001004980-26-000009`). Q2 TOO HARD (NATURE): no rival can build a grid, but whether the franchise protects even the allowed return through California's wildfire liability regime is a forecast the company itself would not write down: its 8-K of 2026-08-31 (`0001999371-26-019256`) says SB 492 "falls short of creating the long-term durability needed"; on 2026-09-02 it opened a strategic review, cut 2027 capital spending from $13.4B to $11.4B and withdrew its 2028 to 2030 forecast (10-Q `0001004980-26-000055`); the Legislature adjourned without reform; the Eaton fire could exhaust the Wildfire Fund asset. Evidence for the business recorded: no catastrophic fire attributed to PG&E since 2022. Peers (cumulative return on average equity FY2016 to FY2025, own filings): PCG -1.8% a year with four loss years and shares x4.40; EIX 8.8%; SDG&E 9.1%; XEL 9.9%. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: equity-only owner cash after maintenance -$1,211M, -$314M, $736M, $3,559M, $3,711M (2021 to 2025), mean $1,296M, 4.50% on the price; the series changes sign so (b) leaves the no-growth case alone: range **$10.66 a share equity-only (central, regulated utility)** against $12.63; fair price **$5.68 equity-only**; all-equity $0.53 at the bond rate, fair negative; no case earns the floor. Facts after the stop: equity cut from $19.2B to $5.1B by the 2018 to 2019 fire losses and rebuilt by issuance, retained earnings -$650M at end-2025; debt $16.9B to $58.2B; a featured core earnings figure that leaves out the Wildfire Fund cost, with the bonus paid on it; six felony counts (San Bruno), 84 involuntary-manslaughter pleas (Camp Fire), the Kincade and Zogg charges settled civilly. Tooling: `tools/run.py PCG` refused the filer (no overlapping annual facts), every figure taken by hand; `Screens/cover_shares.py` prints the gross cover count including the Utility's holding. Dispatcher's check: check_framework PASS; pathspec commits, own paths only; 36 ids and 30 fragments clean (the analyst's check). Contamination declared: other runs' commit subjects and folder names; none opened. Position note filled at the fold: not held. No alert (closed before Q7).
runs.narr: TOO HARD (NATURE) at Q2: a grid no rival can build, inside a wildfire liability regime that its own management has stopped forecasting (strategic review, capital plan cut, 2028 to 2030 outlook withdrawn after the Legislature failed to reform it). Computation only: range $10.66 equity-only vs $12.63, fair $5.68. Four loss years in ten and the share count up 4.4 times. run.py refused this filer outright.
